L1·N13150unmasked layer
Fires on mid-word subword continuation tokens that immediately follow a fragment ending in "p"/"P" (e.g. Ap|oll, P|ADI, p|sp, HPS|A, Lorap|uu), i.e. it's a positional/orthographic detector for the piece after a "p"-final prefix in rare words and acronyms — the opposite sign fires for other such continuations (antip|odes, nap|alm, EP|X).
